parameters.query: INSERT INTO public.site_request_log (endpoint, method, q, slug, filters, status, error, found, result_count, top_results, matched_by, duration_ms, reason, source, auth, user_name, view_id, prefetch, bot) SELECT r.endpoint, r.method, r.q, r.slug, r.filters, r.status, r.error, r.found, r.result_count, r.top_results, r.matched_by, r.duration_ms, r.reason, r.source, r.auth, r.user_name, r.view_id, r.prefetch, r.bot FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS r(endpoint text, method text, q text, slug text, filters jsonb, status text, error text, found boolean, result_count int, top_results jsonb, matched_by text, duration_ms int, reason text, source text, auth text, user_name text, view_id text, prefetch text, bot text)
